top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the GLP-1 chain: human incretin physiology and proglucagon processing, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and receptor biology and translation. Each name covers a distinct, irreplaceable step. The work is mature and independently confirmed, with randomized outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. The citation credits the discoveries and says they enabled the therapies, without claiming priority between Mojsov and Habener. The remaining attribution doubt (Habener, Knudsen) does not justify withholding the prize, so no award ranks last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the 2016 spatial transcriptomics co-authorship and the co-authored works with Sandberg do not touch the B020 candidates
